title: Add a blocking check-iac job to .github/workflows/check.yml
description: Add a job named check-iac to .github/workflows/check.yml in mongodb-mcp-server. It runs on the same triggers as the other jobs (push to main, pull_request). Model its steps on the existing jobs: GitHubSecurityLab/actions-permissions/monitor@v1, then actions/checkout@v6 with persist-credentials: false. The job then runs 'az bicep build --file deploy/azure/bicep/main.bicep --outfile <tmp>/main.json' and checkov 3.3.17, installed from a hash-pinned requirement (pip install --require-hashes) matching the version pinned in the scanner toolchain, with '-d deploy/azure/bicep --framework bicep arm --output sarif'. Do not use --soft-fail, so any failed check fails the job. Upload the SARIF with github/codeql-action/upload-sarif under 'if: always()'. Keep the workflow-level 'permissions: {}' and grant only contents: read and security-events: write at job level. No Azure login or secrets are needed. Follow the policy's single-approval pull request review (approvalsRequired 1); no deployment window applies to a CI-only change.
acceptanceCriteria: '.github/workflows/check.yml' on main contains a check-iac job that runs checkov 3.3.17 against deploy/azure/bicep without --soft-fail, and the job-level permissions are limited to contents: read and security-events: write.
The latest Checks workflow run on main shows check-iac completed successfully, and its SARIF appears under the repository's code scanning alerts with tool name checkov.
A test pull request that adds a known-failing setting to main.bicep (for example ingress allowInsecure: true) makes check-iac fail, and the pull request is then closed unmerged.

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-cicd-env for mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server. Expected result: rule CICD-GATE-05 no longer produces fingerprint 4fc37e101fe1972afc382d0d5fc0e166ac85c932d694ea6a54aae9fc5b52744b, and the PR.IP.S6 observation for the repo shows an IaC scan step present.

rootCause.description: check.yml has only style, generate and dependency jobs. No workflow in the repo runs checkov, tfsec, trivy, kics or a Bicep linter, so template changes reach main unscanned.
